Exposure Classes

```{r}
mapping_path <- "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv"
targeted_mapping <- read_targeted_analyte_mapping(mapping_path)
theme_codes <- targeted_theme_codes(targeted_mapping)

get_theme <- function(category_name) {
  if (category_name %in% names(theme_codes)) {
    unique(theme_codes[[category_name]])
  } else {
    character()
  }
}

Trace_Elements_Theme <- get_theme("TraceElements")
Phenols_Theme <- get_theme("Phenols")
PAH_Theme <- get_theme("PAH")
Phthalates_Theme <- get_theme("Phthalates")
Parabens_Theme <- get_theme("Parabens")
Smoking_Theme <- get_theme("Smoking")
Inflam_Theme <- get_theme("Inflammation")
Pesticide_Theme <- get_theme("Pesticides")
VOC_Theme <- get_theme("VOCs")
OXID_Theme <- get_theme("OxidativeStress")
PFAS_Theme <- get_theme("PFAS")
Flame_Retardant_Theme <- get_theme("FlameRetardants")
PCB_Theme <- get_theme("PCB")
Bisdithiocarbamates_Theme <- get_theme("Bisdithiocarbamates")
CAM_Theme <- get_theme("CellAdhesionMolecules")
Lipids_Theme <- get_theme("Lipids")
Nutrients_Theme <- get_theme("Nutrients")
Lipid_Metab <- get_theme("LipidMetabolism")
Thromboxane <- get_theme("Thromboxane")
Other_Theme <- get_theme("Other")

extract_targeted_group <- function(data_list,
                                   codes,
                                   newcols = c("PID", "Study", "Conc", "Units")) {
  present_codes <- intersect(codes, names(data_list))
  selected <- data_list[present_codes]
  selected <- selected[lengths(selected) != 0]

  if (length(selected) == 0) {
    return(data.table::data.table(
      Outcome = character(),
      PID = character(),
      Study = character(),
      Conc = numeric(),
      Units = character()
    ))
  }

  selected <- lapply(selected, stats::setNames, newcols)
  data.table::rbindlist(selected, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE, idcol = "Outcome")
}
```

```{r}
for(i in seq_along(myanalytes)){
  
  curr_analyte <- myanalytes[i]
  mycols <- c("Child_PID","Study",curr_analyte,"Units")

    rownames_to_column("RN") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Analyte_Code == curr_analyte) %>%

    pivot_wider(names_from = Analyte_Code,values_from = Concentration) %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(mycols))
    
  child_list_Targeted[[i]] <- curr_data
  names(child_list_Targeted)[i] <- curr_analyte
  
}
```

Cum Percent
------



#Trace Elements
```{r}
Trace_Elements_Data <- extract_targeted_group(child_list_Targeted, Trace_Elements_Theme)
Trace_Elements_Data_Mat <- extract_targeted_group(mat_list_Targeted, Trace_Elements_Theme)

Trace_Elements_Data_All <- bind_rows(Trace_Elements_Data,Trace_Elements_Data_Mat)


table(Trace_Elements_Data_All$Units)
Trace_Elements_Data_All <- Trace_Elements_Data_All %>%
  # Shared converter (2026-08-11, audit 1.1). This handled ONLY ug/dL; every
  # other non-ng/mL unit was left as-is.
  mutate(Conc = to_ng_per_mL(Conc, Units)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Conc)) %>% 
  arrange(Conc) %>%
  group_by(Study) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Conc)) %>% 
  mutate(Cat = "Trace_Elements") %>% 
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(Conc),
    cum_percent = cum_freq / sum(Conc) * 100
  ) 

```

Map
------

```{r}
unique(SDOH_Data_All$Location)
```


```{r}
# LOCATION COORDINATES (rewritten 2026-08-11)
#
# Was three parallel vectors of 26 values each -- the same shape that caused the
# off-by-one label bug in Location_QuantileReg_Fixed.R. Rewritten as a tribble so
# each location sits on one line with its own coordinates and cannot desynchronise.
#
# TWO CLASSES OF BUG FIXED HERE:
#
# 1. NAME MISMATCH -- the old table used spaces ("Los Angeles", "Mexico City",
#    "New Hampshire", "NorthEast US", "Southern California", "Washington State",
#    "Central/South America") while Harmonized_SDOH writes underscores. Those seven
#    NEVER joined, so seven established cohorts were silently absent from the map.
#    This was not a new-cohort problem; it predates the new cohorts.
#
# 2. GENUINELY ABSENT -- Accra (GRAPHS), Atlanta (ATLAA) and Thailand (SWSD) are
#    the three new cohorts. Boston (OBSS), California (CTS/IMBEDD/MADRES),
#    Midwestern_US (TSIC), New_York (NYUWHS) and SanFrancisco (GOALS) were never
#    present either.
#
# `United_States` is deliberately NOT given coordinates: seven cohorts (NASH,
# NFGS, SEARCH, TEDDY, VAPS, VDAART, nuMoM2b) record only the country with no
# city, so there is no defensible single point. They drop out of this map and are
# handled in the later plotting step.
#
# Puerto Rico / Nicaragua / Brazil are retained from the original table although
# no cohort currently uses them.
lat_long_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Location,               ~Latitude,  ~Longitude,
  # --- unchanged, already matching ---
  "Baltimore",               39.2904,    -76.6122,
  "Bangladesh",              23.6850,     90.3563,
  "Denver",                  39.7392,   -104.9903,
  "Ecuador",                 -1.8312,    -78.1834,
  "Massachusetts",           42.4072,    -71.3824,
  "Michigan",                44.3148,    -85.6024,
  "Sacramento",              38.5816,   -121.4944,
  "Suriname",                 3.9193,    -56.0278,
  "Syracuse",                43.0481,    -76.1474,
  "Uganda",                   1.3733,     32.2903,
  "Germany",                 51.1657,     10.4515,
  "Finland",                 61.9241,     25.7482,
  "Sweden",                  60.1282,     18.6435,
  "South_Africa",           -30.5595,     22.9375,
  "Tobago",                  11.1828,    -60.7340,
  "Chile",                  -33.4489,    -70.6693,
  # --- renamed to match the data (coordinates unchanged) ---
```

```{r}
pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2//Plots/Chem_Cat_byStudy_Circle.pdf",height = 8,width = 25)



pie_df <- plot_data_map %>%
  mutate(Plot_Study = ifelse(Study == "nuMoM2b", "NUMOM2B",Study)) %>% 
  count(Plot_Study, Cat, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Plot_Study) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prop  = n / total,
    # label position around the ring
    ypos  = cumsum(prop) - 0.5 * prop,
    # show % only for slices >= 6%
    lbl   = ifelse(prop >= 0.06, percent(prop, accuracy = 1), "")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) Center labels (one per facet)
centers <- pie_df %>%
  distinct(Plot_Study, total)


levs <- pie_df %>% distinct(Plot_Study) %>% arrange(Plot_Study) %>% pull(Plot_Study)
pie_df <- pie_df %>% mutate(Plot_Study = factor(Plot_Study, levels = levs))

centers <- pie_df %>%
  distinct(Plot_Study, total) %>%
  mutate(idx = as.integer(Plot_Study))  # 1..n in facet order


# 3) Beautiful faceted donuts
ggplot(pie_df, aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = Cat)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  # slice labels (optional, keep if you want)
  # geom_text(aes(x = 2, y = ypos, label = lbl), size = 3.3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  # BIG facet index in the center
  geom_text(
    data = centers,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, label = idx),      # center of donut
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "gray10"
  ) +
  # (optional) also show total under the index; uncomment to use
  # geom_text(
  #   data = centers,
  #   aes(x = 0, y = 0, label = paste0("\n n=", total)),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   vjust = -0.5, size = 3.3, color = "gray30"
  # ) +
  #xlim(0.5, 2.5) +                       # makes the donut hole
  facet_wrap(~ Plot_Study,nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
  labs(title = "Exposures Per Study", fill = "Exposure Category") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
  )

dev.off()
```

```{r}
plot_data_withidx <- plot_data %>%

pdf(file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2//Plots/Cum_Concentration_Plot.pdf",height = 13,width = 8)


cum_conc <- ggplot(plot_data_withidx, aes(x = log1p(Conc), y = cum_percent, color = Cat, group = Cat)) +
  # Main lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Horizontal median reference line (per Study)
  geom_hline(
    data = med_x,
    aes(yintercept = median_cumPct),
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "grey50",
    linewidth  = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Colors
  scale_color_manual(values = mypal) +
  
  # Axes
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0.01, 0),
    limits = c(0, NA),
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)
    # if cum_percent is 0–1 instead of 0–100, use:
    # labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title    = "Cumulative Percent Within Each Exposure Category",
    subtitle = "By study and exposure category",
    x        = "log(Concentration (ng/mL))",
    y        = "Cumulative percent of participants",
    color    = "Exposure category"
  ) +
  
  # Facets
  facet_wrap(~ Study_num, ncol = 4) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    # Plot title / subtitle
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    
    # Axes
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
    
    # Light panel border/grid vibes
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey80", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    
    # Facet strips
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    
    # Legend
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    legend.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.width  = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      nrow          = 1,
      override.aes  = list(linewidth = 1.5, alpha = 1)
    )
  )

print(cum_conc)
dev.off()

save(cum_conc, file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/cum_conc_plot.RData")
```

```{r}

mapping_path <- "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv"
targeted_mapping <- read_targeted_analyte_mapping(mapping_path)

plot_categories <- c(
  "TraceElements", "Phenols", "Phthalates", "PAH", "PCB", "Parabens",
  "Smoking", "Pesticides", "VOCs", "FlameRetardants", "PFAS"
)



targeted_category_lookup <- targeted_mapping %>%
  dplyr::filter(Category %in% plot_categories) %>%
  dplyr::select(Code, Category) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

theme_codes <- targeted_theme_codes(targeted_mapping)

get_theme <- function(category_name) {
  if (category_name %in% names(theme_codes)) {
    unique(theme_codes[[category_name]])
  } else {
    character()
  }
}

Trace_Elements_Theme <- get_theme("TraceElements")
Phenols_Theme <- get_theme("Phenols")
PAH_Theme <- get_theme("PAH")
Phthalates_Theme <- get_theme("Phthalates")
Parabens_Theme <- get_theme("Parabens")
Smoking_Theme <- get_theme("Smoking")
Inflam_Theme <- get_theme("Inflammation")
Pesticide_Theme <- get_theme("Pesticides")
VOC_Theme <- get_theme("VOCs")
OXID_Theme <- get_theme("OxidativeStress")
PFAS_Theme <- get_theme("PFAS")
Flame_Retardant_Theme <- get_theme("FlameRetardants")
PCB_Theme <- get_theme("PCB")
Other_Theme <- character()

add_plot_category <- function(data, code_col = "Outcome") {
  dplyr::left_join(
    data,
    targeted_category_lookup,
    by = stats::setNames("Code", code_col)
  )
}


chem_table <- plot_data %>% 
  add_plot_category() %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Category)) %>% 
  group_by(Study,Outcome) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>% 
  summarise(All_Chems = paste(Outcome, collapse = ", ")) 

write_csv(chem_table, file ="../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Plots/chem_table_bystudy.csv")
```
